title: Sales Executive
description:
Location: Pune
 Experience: 2+ Years
 Qualification: Bachelors Degree (Mandatory)
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Industry: Healthcare / Senior Living / Premium Services 
 Role Overview We are looking for a target-oriented and relationship-driven Sales Executive to drive customer acquisition, generate leads, close sales, and manage customer relationships across Pune, Mumbai, and Thane. The role involves field sales, on-ground lead generation, relationship building, and customer retention in a premium service environment. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, empathy, and the ability to build lasting relationships with families, senior citizens, doctors, residential societies, and referral partners. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Sales & Business Development Generate and close B2C and B2B sales through direct outreach and relationship-based selling. Conduct in-person and virtual meetings with prospective customers, corporate clients, and residential society representatives. Explain service offerings, pricing, and value propositions effectively. Manage sales pipelines, conduct timely follow-ups, and achieve monthly revenue targets. Maintain accurate CRM records, including lead status, deal value, meeting notes, and next steps. 
 2. Lead Generation & Field Activities Generate qualified leads through residential societies, senior citizen associations, doctor referrals, hospitals, NRI networks, and community organisations. Conduct on-ground promotional activities, awareness drives, and local events. Undertake cold calling, door-to-door outreach, and other prospecting activities where required. Develop and maintain strong referral networks within assigned territories. Meet monthly self-generated lead targets and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. 
 3. Customer Relationship Management & Renewals Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers. Initiate renewal discussions well before contract or plan expiry. Address customer concerns proactively and ensure a positive customer experience. Identify opportunities for upselling and offering additional services. Support customer retention initiatives and minimise churn. 
 4. Customer Experience & Coordination Coordinate with internal operations teams for smooth customer onboarding and service delivery. Ensure proper documentation and timely collection of customer information. Monitor customer concerns and escalate service gaps or sensitive issues to the reporting manager. Maintain high standards of professionalism and customer engagement. 
 5. Reporting & Performance Management Maintain accurate CRM data and timely sales reports. Participate in regular sales reviews and performance discussions. Track sales targets, lead conversions, renewals, and pipeline performance. Follow established sales processes and reporting standards. 
 Required Experience & Qualifications 2+ years of experience in sales, business development, or customer acquisition. Bachelors degree is mandatory. Experience in field sales and relationship-based selling is preferred. Candidates from healthcare, elder care, insurance, medical services, or related industries will be preferred. Familiarity with CRM tools and structured sales processes is an advantage. 
 Required Skills Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Strong relationship-building abilities and customer-centric thinking. Empathy, emotional intelligence, and maturity in handling sensitive situations. Target-driven approach with strong follow-up and time-management skills. Comfortable with extensive fieldwork, local travel, and on-ground activations. Fluency in English and relevant local languages. High integrity, professionalism, and accountability. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Monthly and annual revenue target achievement. Number of self-generated leads. Lead-to-conversion ratio. Customer renewal and retention rates. Reduction in customer churn. CRM accuracy and reporting discipline. Customer satisfaction and feedback. 
 Interested candidates can share their CV at ritiz.raj@in.experis.com

title: Generative AI Engineer- STL, Pune
description:
About the Role:- 
 We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications and autonomous agentic AI systems. You will work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to turn foundation models into reliable, scalable, production-grade solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities:- 
 Design and build applications on top of Large Language Models (open-source and proprietary, such as GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral, and Gemini). Develop agentic AI workflows where LLMs plan, reason, call tools, and execute multi-step tasks using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI. Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector search, and re-ranking. Write clean, modular, and well-tested Python code for data processing, API services, and model integration. Build and expose APIs (FastAPI or Flask) for LLM-based services and integrate them with enterprise systems. Fine-tune or adapt models using techniques such as LoRA/QLoRA and instruction tuning when task requirements justify it. Design prompts, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails to improve output quality, safety, and reliability. Monitor model performance, latency, cost, and hallucination rates in production; iterate based on metrics. Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and DevOps engineers to define requirements and ship features. Stay current with advances in LLMs, agent architectures, and GenAI tooling, and share learnings with the team. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications:- 
 Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. 3+ years of software development experience, with strong proficiency in Python (OOP, async programming, packaging, testing with pytest). Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, or similar). Practical experience with Agentic AI concepts: tool/function calling, ReAct-style reasoning, multi-agent orchestration, and memory management. Working knowledge of RAG architecture and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector). Experience with prompt engineering and evaluation of LLM outputs (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, or custom metrics). Familiarity with REST API development, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Solid understanding of NLP fundamentals, embeddings, and transformer architectures. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly.
